title: Blender needs better upgrading
text: Blender needs better upgrading. Blender needs upgrading. . Can't chop ice for crap. Base is to narrow on the blender. Haven t used the grinder yet so cant say anything yet. The mixer is a okay mixer. Nothing to write home about with this item.

product_metadata.title: Vospeed 5 IN 1 Stand Mixer, 850W Tilt-Head Multifunctional Electric Mixer with 7.5 QT Stainless Steel Bowl, 1.5L Glass Jar, Meat Grinder, Hook, Whisk, Beater Dishwasher Safe - Black
features: 5-in-1 KITCHEN MACHINE - Vospeed kitchen stand mixer is a multi-functional food processor. It is equipped with a dough hook, whisk, beater, juice blender, meat grinder! It’s a perfect kitchen helper for making cakes, bread, cookies, smoothies, juicer,salad, sausage, meat sauce etc. The splash guard helps to add ingredients without making a mess

6 SPEEDS AND PULSE OPTION - The precise 6 speed controller lets you choose from a slow stir to a fast mix, perfectly suitable for different recipes. Additional pulse option can reach the highest speed in seconds which is used for rinsing the juicer cups or making smoothies

POWERFUL MOTOR WITH OVER-HEATING PROTECTION - The cook mixers equipped with a 850 Watt pure copper motor can handle all your work easily. Built-in temperature chip sensor makes the machine shut down automatically when overheating

7.5-QUART HIGH CAPACITY - Big stainless steel bowl with handles can meet all your needs in the kitchen. The 1.5L glass jar is perfect for making juice for you family. The planetary stirring system makes the mixing thoroughly and evenly

5 YEAR WARRANTY AND 7*24H CUSTORMER SERVICE - Vospeed standing mixer comes with 5 year quality warranty. Please feel free to contact our customer service team if you encounter any problem. We will contact you within 24 hours
